# Unregistered Pagination Component Triggers Vue Warning
Popup used unregistered `<pagination>` tag causing `[Vue warn]: Unknown custom element`.

## Description
- Project: 苏州市房地产监测V3 (zhi2-web-admin).
- 5 files including contractDialog.vue replaced `<pagination>` with global `<zs-pagination>`.
- Pagination props and `@pagination` event kept unchanged.

## Root Cause
- `<pagination>` was not globally registered, causing Vue warning in dialogs.

## Fix
- Replace `<pagination>` with `<zs-pagination>` in contractDialog.vue and 4 other files.
- Maintain same props and event binding.

# Detail Container Height Scoping Fix
`.detail-container` had hardcoded height causing bottom blank; scoping fixed.

## Description
- Project: 苏州市房地产监测V3 (zhi2-web-admin), file src/styles/index.scss.
- `.detail-container { height: calc(100vh - 120px); }` over-subtracted 16px vs actual header 104px.
- Caused 40px bottom blank and truncated title; 468 references in el-dialog affected.

## Fix
- Scope style to `#app-main.app-main:has(> .detail-container)` to avoid affecting el-dialog references.

# Watermark Occlusion By High Z-index Components
Detail page sticky bar and table fixed columns blocked watermark; fixed by body-level watermark.

## Description
- Project: 苏州市房地产监测V3 (zhi2-web-admin).
- Sticky operation bar (z-index:14), table fixed columns (12-13), v-loading mask (2000) higher than #app-main watermark (z-index:5) caused occlusion.
- Local watermark invisible in those areas.

## Fix
- Mount watermark layer on document.body with position:fixed, update alignment via ResizeObserver and scroll/resize.
- Global z-index:1990 to avoid blocking Element dialogs.

# Grid Offset Missing Causes Column Misalignment
Full-width grid row lacking gridOffset caused next row misalignment; fixed with gridOffset.

## Description
- Project: 苏州市房地产监测V3 (zhi2-web-admin), presale permit cancel/extend details.
- "行政区划+项目坐落" filled 24 grid columns; "统一社会信用代码" wrapped to column 1, not aligned to column 3.

## Fix
- In view state DetailTemplate add gridOffset; buildCancelBasicInfoView set gridOffset:{lg:16}.
- In edit state use lg=16 placeholder + credit code lg=8 to align column 3.
